s5.title: 1796 RoboTigers | Behind the Bumpers | 2025 FRC REEFSCAPE Robot

cycle.text: Coral goes into the hopper, where wheels center it and printed parts turn it straight. A funnel guides it into the coral end effector, and the elevator raises it to L2, L3 or L4.
An alliance partner planned for it to run supercycles at Hudson Valley, scoring coral and putting algae in the net.

changed.text: The hopper began as a prototype with no CAD; coral stuck, so the panel angle changed and printed pieces now hold it. Suspension cable was added to a wobbling elevator just before the first event, and carbon fiber supports for the later events.

outcome.text: 53-5-0 in official play; ranked 7 of the pooled top 20 (OPR 110.26, Daly).

auto.text: An alliance partner's notes on their first Hudson Valley playoff match give it a 3.5-piece auto on reef positions F, D and C.

endgame.text: An alliance partner says its climb was wearing down at Hudson Valley, so in the playoffs it would line up with the cage and climb only in close matches; it did deep climb in the last final.

solves.text: Take coral wherever the robot is, even when an opponent plays heavy defense

cost.text: Coral stuck in the first version until the panel angle changed

facts.text: Polycarbonate on three sides, at a set angle held by 3D printed pieces
Wheels center the coral, and printed parts turn it to the one angle the scoring mechanism needs
One Kraken drives it at about a 3:1 ratio
Inspired by the team captioned as Mechanical Advantage; the robot is named for its likeness to a french fry container

solves.text: Raise coral to L2, L3 and L4 without wobbling

cost.text: It wobbled a lot before the first event, and its first supports wore down over time

facts.text: The 2024 elevator made longer, with more supports; inspired by Team 4414's 2023 robot
Three layers of support: a 3D printed piece, suspension cable and carbon fiber

solves.text: Score at one angle and stop coral jamming on its way from the hopper

facts.text: A bent plate sets the angle, about
A funnel piece guides coral from the hopper, at what had been one of the biggest jamming points in testing
The host describes a combined system of algae and coral manipulators

decisions.because: it worked well for the amp in 2024

decisions.because: coral was getting stuck in the first stage, which showed the panel angle had to change

decisions.choice: Add a guide funnel between hopper and end effector
decisions.because: coral often jammed there in testing
